item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: a relaxation exercise in the evening and a set bedtime a little after ten. That structure works only if you keep it. Protect the hour before bed. Put screens away, dim the lights, and let your mind finish the day's loose ends on paper instead of in bed. Tonight, start your relaxation exercise on time, and don't negotiate with it.
